summary.en-US: A point-and-click, matrix-based firewall: for each site you visit, choose which other sites it may connect to and what they may load. A maintained fork of uMatrix.

version.approval_notes: Source: https://github.com/dmolik/crossbar (the uploaded source archive is that repository at the release tag). Build: ./tools/make-firefox.sh <tag>, which only copies files and writes the version into manifest.json; nothing is minified or bundled. The .wasm files are compiled from the .wat files next to them with wat2wasm.
